item.title: Top 7 Ways to Disable Missing Docstring Warnings at a File-Level in Pylint
item.description: Pylint often raises alerts when it detects that your code files are not following docstring practices. Sometimes, you might find yourself in a situation where you want to maintain internal documentation for classes and functions without the necessity of including a file-level docstring. Fortunately, there are several methods to configure Pylint to ignore these warnings while still keeping core linting features active. Here are the top seven techniques to achieve this customization.
